plan.title: recurrence(#5278): query-before Class A push/PR-open while stop-at:pr-open leaf still live

narratives.Description: Parent Class A push/PR-open goes through runParentClassAPublication after green subagent:pre-class-a tip-schema admit while a stop-at:pr-open leaf is live.
narratives.Overview: Prefer-A Bound Recut-3 6328905032: tip-schema Class A admit; sibling subagent:pre-class-a via evaluatePreClassA; publication-owning runParentClassAPublication; current-attempt identity bind; thin docs next to #5278.
narratives.Labels: bug, swarm, agent-experience, process, urgent, design-critique:ingest-ready, framework-gap, promise:swarm
narratives.UserStory: As a through-merge parent, I want Class A push and gh pr create to refuse until a live stop-at:pr-open leaf tip-schema admit is green so that I cannot publish while the leaf is still mid-work.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Add packages/core/src/swarm/class-a-publication.ts runParentClassAPublication (probe-then-publish) with unit coverage for admit/deny/stale/force and red/config blocking publish.
2. Add evaluatePreClassA helpers in packages/core/src/orchestration/subagent-steer.ts and packages/runtime/src/subagent-pre-class-a.ts sibling verb mirroring pre-cancel.
3. Wire swarm:pre-dispatch --action class-a and dispatch.ts verb map into the owning publish function; thin docs next to #5278.
4. CHANGELOG Unreleased entry.
